description: 52 frozen HuggingFace checkpoints (28 weight lineages, 11 families) each scored by four activation-only safety scores, paired with the judged plain-harmful refusal rate y_refusal. One row per checkpoint; no model weights or GPU needed to reproduce the statistics.
framing: The logit-gap harmful margin reads the margin ON HARMFUL PROMPTS. The saving is no generation, no judge, no benchmark, no reference model. It is NOT harmful-prompt-free.
